housing: Many Memphis rentals are single-family houses, a large share owned by investors, along with garden-style apartment complexes in the east and older duplexes in Midtown.

tenantHelp.name: Memphis Area Legal Services

climate: Hot, humid summers make working air conditioning essential; check for mold, water stains and signs of pests such as termites and roaches, and photograph them at move-in.
fact: Memphis has many investor-owned single-family rentals, so your landlord may be a company based in another state, which makes a dated move-in record especially useful.
